item.title: How to handle fetch errors in JavaScript
item.description: Proper fetch error handling is essential for building robust applications that gracefully manage network failures, server errors, and unexpected responses. As the creator of CoreUI with extensive JavaScript experience since 2000, I’ve implemented comprehensive error handling in countless API integrations and data-driven applications. From my expertise, the most reliable approach is checking both network errors and HTTP response status codes with appropriate fallback strategies. This technique ensures applications remain functional even when network requests fail.
